 CENTRAL VALLEY (FOX26) — Thousands of PG & E customers across the Central Valley are without electricity as storms continue to cause power outages.
 According to PG & E's outage map, several areas are experiencing significant disruptions, including 723 customers near Pine Flat Lake, more than 800 in central Fresno and over 900 in the Laton and Hanford area.
 [RELATED] Power restored to more than 7,000 following storm-related outage in Clovis 
 PG & E crews are working to restore electricity, with estimated restoration times varying by location.
 Residents can check the latest outage information and estimated restoration times through PG & E's online outage map or mobile app.
